# Crayon Roofing & Structures — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary

This corpus contains a large number of short WhatsApp/phone call snippets from Crayon Roofing and Structures (factory/office at **Manali, Andarkuppam check post, Chennai**). A majority of the recordings are **not real sales calls** — they are internal ops chatter about Diwali gift distribution, courier/vehicle dispatch, loading, bill-copy handovers, payment-collection follow-ups, and staff banter. These were excluded.

What remains as genuine sales material is still substantial: **~50-60 real customer-facing calls** covering inbound enquiries, rate negotiations, dealer/field-sales conversations, and order-taking for roofing sheets and allied hardware. The sample is good enough to build a working playbook, though many calls are truncated or get interrupted mid-negotiation (lines drop, customer is "driving", or call transfers happen). Treat quantitative "effective lines" as indicative, not statistically proven.

## Products & brand ladder

Crayon Roofing and Structures is primarily a **metal roofing sheet manufacturer/trader** (coil-fed, profile-pressed on their own line at Manali) plus a reseller of associated hardware. Products that actually came up in calls:

- **Metal roofing sheets (trapezoidal/corrugated profile)** — core product. "நம்ம company-ல Crayon Roofing and Structures JSW Roofing Sheets apply பண்ணிட்டு இருக்கோம்." Thickness range mentioned: 0.45mm, 0.47mm, 0.50mm, 0.6mm (0.7mm NOT stocked — "அவ்வளவுக்கு 7mm-ல இல்ல Sir 0.6mm-ல sky blue available").
- **Brand ladder** (multiple brands run on the same line, customer chooses):
  - **JSW Color On Plus** — premium line, 0.47/0.50mm — "JSW Pragathi branded Pragathi color of plus madam 445 + GST"
  - **JSW Radiance** — alternate JSW grade, used interchangeably with Color On Plus in rate talk
  - **Asian / Asian Indira Dhanush / Asian Force** — mid brand — "Asian Force .45 இந்திர தனுஷ் 370+ GST"
  - **Pragathi** — "Pragathi ₹410 + tax வரும் sir" / later "Pragathi Sky Blue"
  - **Silver On** — JSW sub-brand, "Silver-on கொஞ்சம் விலை அதிகம், JSW Steel கொஞ்சம் விலை கம்மி"
  - Occasional competitor name-drops for context: Tata, Apollo, Amar, Everlast, Sarva Steel, Bharat Roofing/Pragati.
- **PUFF insulated panels** (roof + wall cladding) — separate factory line, not Manali stock — "நம்மளோட இன்னொரு factory-ல tile profile sheet-ஓட இது இருக்கு... puff-ஓட இதெல்லாம் இருக்கு." 50mm/40mm/30mm thickness; rate example "₹1650 + tax வரும் square meter" for 50mm puff.
- **Polycarbonate / FRP sheets** — 1.5mm, 1.8mm, 2mm standard stock; "transparent" Lexan up to 15 feet standard length; 3-4mm customised on request only for bulk ("quantity ரொம்ப கம்மியா கேக்குறீங்க... அதிகமா இருந்தா பண்ணலாம்").
- **Accessories**: L-flash, ridge, gutter, cutter/crimp pieces, barge board — all made to diagram, standard width 610mm beyond which rate doubles ("610mm-க்குள்ள 3 பக்கமும் complete பண்றது ₹655... 610mm-க்கு மேல போச்சுனாலே full sheet use பண்ற மாதிரி... double the rate").
- **Screws** — Tata Agri-Go self-drilling screws, multiple sizes (1 inch, 2 inch, M8x55 full-thread, 2.5 inch full thread, rust-free variants), sold in "box/cotton (carton)" units.
- **Welding rods** — Tata and "Raasi" brand, box/case/packet-based slabs with running schemes.
- **MS Channels** — JSW brand structural channel (125/65), handled by a separate contact person.
- **GI sheet / MS corrugated sheet** — enquired about but **not stocked** ("GI sheet நம்மகிட்ட available இல்லை sir. Metal roofing sheet தான் இருக்குது"; "1.2mm MS corrugated sheet... நம்ம metal roofing sheet தான் பண்ணிட்டு இருக்கோம்").
- **UPVC sheet / tile-pattern UPVC** — explicitly **not made** ("UPVC நம்மகிட்ட available இல்லை sir").
- **Liner sheet** — repeatedly asked about, company does **not** produce it and reps are told to check competitors (Arumuga Steel, "ஆரம்ப ஸ்டீல்").

## Real rates & terms (only rates that actually appear in the calls)

- JSW Color On Plus 0.47mm: **₹420 + GST / sq.m** (one call), another call quotes **₹445 + GST / sq.m** for the same grade — rates clearly fluctuate week to week.
- JSW Color On Plus 0.47 royal blue, bulk order: **₹1466 + 18% GST per 10-ft sheet** in one retail-shop call.
- Asian Indira Dhanush AZ70GSM 0.45mm (no ASW/other coating option): "370+ GST square meter" / another call "0.45mm Asian Indradhanush... 1251 + 18% GST + loading charge" for a 10-ft sheet.
- Pragathi: **₹410 + tax/sq.m** in one call; **₹445+GST** context in another; coil rate "profile 101 plus tax" / "coil ₹3 குறைச்சுக்கங்க, 98... அவங்களுக்கு 97 வரும்."
- GST is always **18%**, always **added on top**, and cash-without-GST billing is explicitly refused: "இல்ல sir. without GST பண்ண முடியாது. Sir, with GST தான் full-ஆவே."
- Screws (Tata Agri):
  - 1 inch full carton: **₹2.93 + tax** (carton ≈ ₹2500, ~200/box small pack)
  - 2 inch full carton: **₹4.44 + tax**; retail/dealer small-qty: **₹4.66 + tax**
  - M8 self-drilling 55mm: quoted at **₹4.44/₹4.45 + tax**
  - 2.5" full-thread (Agri-Go) small master box = 200 pcs; rate **₹5.95 + 18% GST** per box-equivalent in one call.
- Welding rod: dealer/consumer slab example "₹356 including tax" per packet; another mention "₹302 + tax" and a competitor undercut to "₹300".
- PUFF 50mm panel: **₹1650 + GST / sq.m** (works out ~₹2000/sq.m after tax, described as "running meter" calculation for narrow widths).
- Polycarbonate 2mm: **₹800 + GST / sq.m** (12-ft FRP enquiry).
- Standard L-flash/cutter accessory: up to 610mm combined width = **₹655/piece**; beyond that, rate doubles.
- **Payment terms (stated explicitly)**: "50% advance payment, balance 50% வந்து delivery-க்கு முன்னாடி payment பண்ணனும் sir" — confirmed again for Meetech Design: "50% advance... remaining வைல் delivery... பேமெண்ட் பண்ணா மட்டும்தான் வண்டி ரிலீஸ் பண்ண முடியும்."
- **Transport/delivery is customer's scope**: "vehicle உங்க scope தான் வரும்" / "Freight excluded, transportation your scope."
- Long-distance orders are actively discouraged: a Tirunelveli customer was told "ரொம்ப long distance-ஆ இருக்கும்... உங்க local-லயே நீங்க check பண்ணி பார்க்கலாம்."

## Objection Playbook

| Objection | How it was actually handled in the calls |
|---|---|
| "Cash bill-ஆ, GST இல்லாம பண்ண முடியுமா?" | Flatly declined: "இல்ல sir. without GST பண்ண முடியாது." No discount offered to compensate — straight no. |
| "Rate கொஞ்சம் கம்மி பண்ணுங்க" | Reps routinely say "நான் sir-கிட்ட கேட்டு சொல்றேன்" (escalate to owner/manager) rather than self-authorize a discount. One field rep negotiated a **₹5/sq.m** shave: "₹5 கம்மி பண்ணி அனுப்பிச்சிருக்கேன்." |
| Customer confused about unit (sq.ft vs sq.m vs kg) | Reps patiently convert and re-quote in kg/running-meter when customer insists: "kg-கிலோ ரேட்டு 120 + GST" and manually compute weight-based equivalence. |
| Customer wants non-stock item (UPVC, GI sheet, liner sheet, 0.7mm) | Honest redirection, no false promise: "நம்மகிட்ட available இல்லை sir. Metal roofing sheet தான் இருக்குது." For liner sheet, reps proactively researched competitors (Arumuga Steel) for the customer instead of losing the lead cold. |
| Wastage / odd-size disputes (cutter/L-flash width) | Rep explains the technical reason precisely (standard width 610mm, beyond that full sheet consumed) rather than just quoting a number — builds trust: "610mm-க்குள்ள இருந்துச்சுன்னா 655 வ
